metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for measuring critical section contention impact on multi-threaded throughput scaling. It differs semantically from peer candidates: it measures bottleneck saturation point (not optimization ablation or timestamp conflict detection), uses thread-count scaling methodology (not transaction-level comparison or validation logic), and targets the optimization_evaluation stage. No existing skill in the registry matches this capability. Support evidence from section 6.4 confirms the relevance of critical section bottleneck analysis in OCC systems.
